item.stem:
The diagram shows a number line with $\sqrt{2}$ marked. Hemant checks $1.41^{2}=1.9881$ and $1.42^{2}=2.0164$.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims follow?

options.B: Report $1.41$ itself as the exact value of $\sqrt{2}$.
options.C: The same bracketing also holds if the trial bounds are taken as $-1.41$ and $-1.42$.
options.D: Closer positive decimals whose squares still bracket $2$ keep $\sqrt{2}$ between those decimals.
